court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: 24th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Borivali - Criminal Case No.227/PW/2022
case_name: Mahesh Kisan Gorad And Anr vs Pooja Mahesh Gorad And Anr
facts_of_case: The applicants seek quashing of the F.I.R bearing C.R. No.129 of 2021 registered with Charkop Police Station, Mumbai for alleged offences punishable under sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506, 509 of IPC. The parties have filed a Divorce petition under section 13 (1) (b) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 seeking divorce by mutual consent.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish that the FIR is frivolous and without any substance.
legal_principles.held: It appears that the applicants seek quashing of the F.I.R bearing C.R. No.129 of 2021 registered with Charkop Police Station, Mumbai for the alleged offences punishable under sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506, 509 of the Indian Penal Code.

legal_principles.principle: A mutual consent divorce petition can be filed even if the parties are involved in a pending criminal case.
legal_principles.held: It appears that in the interregnum, the parties i.e applicant No.1 and respondent No.1 have filed a Divorce petition under section 13 (1) (b) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 bearing M.P. No.430 of 2022 seeking divorce by mutual consent.

outcome.final_order: The application is taken up for final disposal and the F.I.R bearing C.R. No.129 of 2021 is quashed.
